Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to be an athlete?

No. Sports massage can be adapted for recreational exercise, physically demanding work and regular training.

Can I book before or after an event?

Yes, but the appropriate timing and techniques differ. Tell the therapist about your activity and schedule before the session.

Can sports massage treat an injury?

Massage may support comfort and recovery, but it does not diagnose injuries or replace medical evaluation.
